findings.claim: Research source metadata passes the competitor validator
findings.issue: CLI validate currently fails Unknown source project: discovery records use project_id candidates, outside accepted project IDs. Discovery records must be assigned to actual projects or supported by an explicit separate schema.
findings.resolution: Discovery source IDs retained while project_id values were mapped to stox/rektrade/parchment; independent final validator passed98sources/67metrics.

checks.name: Independent focused tests
checks.details: Final independent focused rerun:16/16tests passed using bundledNode, including new snapshot unit/source/coverage/window regression. Zero network.

checks.name: Immutable capture/replay scope
checks.details: Seven retained collector runs passed readRun source/order/hash validation; eight response hashes checked; two pure buildReport evaluations per run matched. No refresh or network run during review. Test suite also rejects capture overwrite, bytes/source tampering and response traversal.

checks.name: Metric boundary review
checks.details: Empty TVL stays null; TVL never becomes bankroll. Provider rolling fees retain unknown exact boundaries and narrow fee semantics. Cardboard cumulative vs 24h fields differ; USD6 is explicit. Rektrade stats timestamps are not inherited by its untimed house response. Missing activity, aligned7d and independently reconciled PnL remain null.

checks.name: Access policy review
checks.details: Collector fixed GET allowlist, omitted credentials, manual redirects, timeout/size/request limits and stop after401/403/429 reviewed. No-adapter sources make zero requests.

checks.name: Independent source/capture checks
checks.details: Six Papertrade/STOX captures and baseline review digest matched. STOX launchTime independently converted to2026-10-20T00:12:28Z. All48 successful scout captures matched (Cardboard17, TradeEverything20, Rektrade7, discovery4); source metadata hashes match ledgers. Discovery has5 attempts/4 successful captures; no denial retries made in review.

checks.name: Key candidate claims
checks.details: Cardboard operator/fees/freeze/queue and top-level75008trades/1388users checked. TradeEverything model attribution/routing-vs-independent-market conflict, draft status, mixed50/50queue and502mainnet reads checked. Rektrade API params/mint conflict/counts/sevenmarket scope checked. Advisory: config market leverage differs from markets endpoint; author notified to preserve the conflict. Final recheck confirms leverage-cap advisory resolved bilingually; TE now also records pricing-page immediate-payment versus delayed-queue conflict; raw pricing text checked. STOX now accurately separates this dossier403 from parallel scout200, without authenticity or first-trade inference.

checks.name: Final research validator
checks.details: Independent CLI validate accepted98sources and67snapshotmetrics. Inspected new numeric-source/evidence/coverage and paired-window guards and their focused regression.

checks.name: Published numeric snapshot reconstruction
checks.details: Loaded the six runs named by latest.json with readRun, rebuilt every report offline, concatenated67metrics; JSON exactly matches public snapshot. No writes to captures or network.

checks.name: Root bilingual comparison
checks.details: Displayed TVL/fee/notional/count/cash/queue/OI numbers and two-decimal rounding match latest.json. Missing current YOLO House/leaderboard and TE/STOX business metrics remain unknown; source windows, notional/cash, TVL/bankroll, queued/paid and zero-queue boundaries are preserved. YOLO summary was checked against existing source records and separately captured profit-fee metrics, not independently re-authenticated official pages.

limitations: Review is bounded to high-impact evidence/metric issues, not a complete contract or source authenticity audit.
YOLO dossier and its sourceJSON were authored by this reviewer and are explicitly excluded from independent review.
Preflight reader sources without raw captures were checked for accurate limitations, not independently authenticated.
No new public-source, wallet, chain, credential or transaction reads occurred during review.
Source truth, wash trading, full historical coverage, legal identity and deployed execution are not established by passing tests or hashes.
Files are recorded at SHA-256; later edits require explicit recheck.
Exact review start timestamp was not recorded; started_at remains null.
Final comparison and latest.json received the stated bounded checks; latest.csv, refresh/progress guides, verification.json and review-data.json were not independently checked in this review.
Final TypeScript check was reported by root but was not independently rerun by this reviewer.
All checked-file hashes were updated only after reading the changed scopes; future edits require recheck.
